title: Historical format
description: The top-level record tying together everything that defines one historical format. A format is mostly a set of REFERENCES into the shared datasets (banlists, pools, rule profiles); it should contain as little inline data as possible so that shared facts are stored exactly once.

id.description: Chronologically sortable id, e.g. 2005-04-goat. Must match the directory name formats/<id>/.

start.description: First day the format's defining conditions held (usually a banlist effective date).

end.description: Last day, if known. null while unresearched.

snapshot.description: The single representative date used for cutoff calculations (card pool, errata applicability). Usually the date of the format's defining event or the community-accepted reference point.

previous.description: Format id of the predecessor. May name a format not yet in the repository; the validator warns (not fails) on unresolved ids.

banlist.description: id of a banlist snapshot in data/banlists/.

card_pool.description: id of a pool definition in data/pools/.

rule_profile.description: id of a rule profile in data/rule-profiles/.

errata_policy.description: computed: tooling selects every erratum whose change post-dates this format's snapshot and applies the historical version. none: format explicitly opts out of historical card overrides.

errata_overrides.description: Explicit corrections to the computed erratum selection, used while change dates are still unresearched or when a source establishes format-specific applicability (e.g. a reference implementation). Dated errata should eventually make include entries unnecessary.

include.description: erratum ids whose historical version applies in this format regardless of (missing) dates.

relevant_products.description: Set/product codes (matching data/releases/) that frame this format, e.g. the last legal set.
